tasks.prompt: Inputs a,b are arbitrary integers. Return -1 if either is outside 0..255; otherwise return their bit-mask intersection as an integer. Output only Python source defining f(a, b), with optional int/bool annotations and no defaults. Allowed: integer/bool literals, local assignments, if/else, return, comparisons, and/or/not, + - * // % & | ^ ~ << >>. No imports, calls, loops or other syntax. All intermediate integers must fit signed 128 bits; shift counts must be 0..63.

Inputs a,b are guaranteed integers in 0..255. Return bool: all flags in required mask b are present in available mask a. Zero required flags succeeds. No out-of-domain validation is required. Output only Python source defining f(a, b), with optional int/bool annotations and no defaults. Allowed: integer/bool literals, local assignments, if/else, return, comparisons, and/or/not, + - * // % & | ^ ~ << >>. No imports, calls, loops or other syntax. All intermediate integers must fit signed 128 bits; shift counts must be 0..63.

Inputs a,b are arbitrary integers. Return -1 if either is outside 0..255; otherwise decode two little-endian bytes a then b as an unsigned integer. Output only Python source defining f(a, b), with optional int/bool annotations and no defaults. Allowed: integer/bool literals, local assignments, if/else, return, comparisons, and/or/not, + - * // % & | ^ ~ << >>. No imports, calls, loops or other syntax. All intermediate integers must fit signed 128 bits; shift counts must be 0..63.

Input a is guaranteed an unsigned 16-bit integer; b is guaranteed 0 or 1. Return byte b of a in little-endian order as an integer. No out-of-domain validation is required. Output only Python source defining f(a, b), with optional int/bool annotations and no defaults. Allowed: integer/bool literals, local assignments, if/else, return, comparisons, and/or/not, + - * // % & | ^ ~ << >>. No imports, calls, loops or other syntax. All intermediate integers must fit signed 128 bits; shift counts must be 0..63.

Inputs a,b are arbitrary integers. A table has b slots, each 8 bytes. Return byte offset of slot a. Return -1 unless 0 <= b <= 255 and 0 <= a < b. Output only Python source defining f(a, b), with optional int/bool annotations and no defaults. Allowed: integer/bool literals, local assignments, if/else, return, comparisons, and/or/not, + - * // % & | ^ ~ << >>. No imports, calls, loops or other syntax. All intermediate integers must fit signed 128 bits; shift counts must be 0..63.

Inputs a,b are guaranteed integers with 0 <= a <= 255 and 0 <= b <= 255. Return bool: a is a valid zero-based slot index for a table with b slots. A zero-slot table has no valid index. Output only Python source defining f(a, b), with optional int/bool annotations and no defaults. Allowed: integer/bool literals, local assignments, if/else, return, comparisons, and/or/not, + - * // % & | ^ ~ << >>. No imports, calls, loops or other syntax. All intermediate integers must fit signed 128 bits; shift counts must be 0..63.

Inputs a,b are arbitrary integers. Return bytes occupied by a units of b bytes each. Return -1 unless 0 <= a <= 31 and 1 <= b <= 16. Output only Python source defining f(a, b), with optional int/bool annotations and no defaults. Allowed: integer/bool literals, local assignments, if/else, return, comparisons, and/or/not, + - * // % & | ^ ~ << >>. No imports, calls, loops or other syntax. All intermediate integers must fit signed 128 bits; shift counts must be 0..63.

Inputs a,b are guaranteed integers with 0 <= a <= 255 and 1 <= b <= 16. Return the count of complete b-byte units fitting in a bytes. Discard leftover bytes; no out-of-domain validation is required. Output only Python source defining f(a, b), with optional int/bool annotations and no defaults. Allowed: integer/bool literals, local assignments, if/else, return, comparisons, and/or/not, + - * // % & | ^ ~ << >>. No imports, calls, loops or other syntax. All intermediate integers must fit signed 128 bits; shift counts must be 0..63.
